root_cause.text: The `xe_exec_ioctl` and `vm_bind_ioctl_check_args` functions in the Intel Xe DRM driver lack bounds checking on the user-supplied `num_syncs` parameter, allowing userspace to trigger an excessively large kernel memory allocation.
root_cause.evidence: The patch introduces `DRM_XE_MAX_SYNCS` (set to 1024) and adds validation checks (`args->num_syncs > DRM_XE_MAX_SYNCS`) in `xe_exec_ioctl` and `vm_bind_ioctl_check_args` to reject oversized requests, preventing the page allocator warnings triggered when `xe_exec_ioctl` calls `kmalloc_array_noprof` with an arbitrary `num_syncs` value.
